extracted.intended_audience: researchers and clinicians conducting or using scoping reviews of urinary incontinence treatments
extracted.subtask_short: PRISMA-ScR scoping review on UI treatments
extracted.subtask_description: A registered scoping review protocol that will map pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatments for adult urinary incontinence using the PRISMA-ScR framework, cataloging intervention types and indications, summarizing outcome domains, identifying evidence clusters and gaps, and producing an evidence map, narrative synthesis, and tables of study characteristics. No meta-analysis is planned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PRISMA-ScR methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: This scoping review will be conducted using PRISMA-ScR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews) reporting framework to structure search, selection, data charting, and reporting processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population scope — adults with urinary incontinence
rubrics_metrics.description: Map the breadth of treatments for urinary incontinence (UI) in adults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict included studies to adult populations; explicitly state population eligibility in selection criteria and data extraction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intervention scope — pharmacological and non-pharmacological
rubrics_metrics.description: Include both pharmacological (e.g., antimuscarinics, β3-agonists, onabotulinumtoxinA) and non-pharmacological approaches (e.g., pelvic floor muscle training, bladder training, neuromodulation, pessaries, lifestyle, surgery).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catalog intervention types and indications comprehensively across both domains; use provided examples as illustrative inclusion categories but be open to other modalities encountered in the literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalog intervention types and indications
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematically record and categorize the types of interventions and the clinical indications for which they are used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract intervention names, modality, dosage/parameters where applicable, target indication (e.g., stress vs urgency UI), and context of use to populate the evidence map and tables of study characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summarize outcome domains
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize outcome domains including continence, leakage frequency, quality of life (QoL), and adverse effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chart which outcome domains each study reports, the outcome measures used, time points, and measurement instruments to allow comparison across studies and identification of outcome heterogeneity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify evidence clusters and gaps
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify clusters of evidence and gaps, for example long-term safety, real-world effectiveness, and device trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map areas with substantial research activity vs areas with limited or no evidence; explicitly flag topics lacking long-term data, effectiveness research outside trials, or underrepresented intervention types (e.g., device trials).

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce an evidence map
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate an evidence map showing the distribution of studies across intervention types, indications, and outcome domains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the collected study characteristics and outcome summaries to create visual/tabular evidence maps that highlight volume and coverage of research by modality and domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide narrative synthesis by modality
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative synthesis organized by intervention modality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize findings qualitatively for each modality (pharmacological and non-pharmacological), discussing patterns, strengths, and limitations of the evidence without quantitatively pooling results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tabulate study characteristics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include key study details (e.g., design, sample size, population, intervention details, outcomes measured, follow-up) in structured tables to support the evidence map and narrative synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: No meta-analysis planned
rubrics_metrics.description: The protocol specifies that no meta-analysis is planned for this scoping review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan for qualitative mapping and synthesis only; state rationale for not pooling (e.g., heterogeneity of interventions/outcomes) and consider whether any subset of sufficiently homogeneous studies might later warrant quantitative synthesis.
